_comment: Laboratory items added on top of heroesContents (server exports, through content_additions.connect) and the client copy (scripts/client/apply_lab_content_additions.py: heroes.db3 rows, English text packs, player_costume.txt entries and packs of the files in .cache/private-assets/<assets>, which are never versioned). Each item copies every row of its template in content_additions.TABLES, with ItemClass replaced and the 'set' columns changed. Item editor (docs/future/item-editor.md, section 3): fiona_inner_fringe uses the unused inner armor entry 16 (fiona_inner_fringe.mdl) and its existing icon (cut 1); fiona_inner_zero adds entry 9100 with a model supplied by the operator (MDL version 48, the 1.69 models are 44).
